label: Cinematic wild raven mid-play (premium wildlife, near-monochrome)
prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic 16:9 YouTube thumbnail with Planet Earth documentary quality. A single wild raven caught mid-play, tumbling upside-down through the air with wings half-spread and a mischievous, joyful energy, against a moody dark charcoal-grey sky with soft directional light and shallow depth of field. The bird is razor sharp and dramatically lit, its black feathers catching a delicate off-white rim light; the background falls away into rich dark negative space. Sophisticated, near-monochrome colour grade — charcoal #323232 and off-white #f8f8f8 only, with a single tiny pop of red #aa0a0a (a small band on the bird's leg, the one accent in the frame). One small elegant off-white word 'play' in refined lowercase sits discreetly in the lower-left. The ONLY text is 'play'. Premium, mysterious, cinematic — the opposite of clickbait. Keep the bottom-right corner clear. Legible at small size.

label: Suited adult absorbed in a childish game (human paradox, 'WHY?')
prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. A serious adult man in a sharp dark charcoal tailored suit is crouched low on the polished floor of a moody dark studio, completely absorbed in flicking a single marble, shot from a low dramatic angle with one hard key light and deep cinematic shadows. His expression is intent, almost childlike concentration — strikingly incongruous with the powerful formal suit. The tension of a serious, important adult utterly focused on a pointless childish game is the entire image. Charcoal #323232 and off-white #f8f8f8 palette; the marble is a single glossy red #aa0a0a — the only colour accent. Generous dark negative space above him. Bold off-white condensed sans-serif text in the upper area reads exactly 'WHY?'. The ONLY text is 'WHY?'. Premium, cinematic, unexpected, thought-provoking. Keep the bottom-right corner clear.

label: Playing fawn + lurking predator (danger paradox, 'DEADLY?')
prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic 16:9 YouTube thumbnail with high tension, film-still quality. In the sharply-lit foreground, a young fox kit leaps and plays joyfully, carefree, mid-pounce. In the soft-focus darkness behind it lurks the ominous silhouette of a large predator watching, only just readable in the gloom. The juxtaposition of innocent play and lurking lethal danger is the point of the image. Deep moody charcoal #323232 palette, dramatic low-key lighting, off-white #f8f8f8 highlights on the kit; a single faint red #aa0a0a glint in the predator's eye is the only colour accent. Bold off-white condensed sans-serif text in the lower-left reads exactly 'DEADLY?'. The ONLY text is 'DEADLY?'. Suspenseful, cinematic, premium. Keep the bottom-right corner clear. Legible when small.

label: Brain rebuilt from playground equipment (distinctive illustration, 'PLAY')
prompt: A beautifully rendered conceptual 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, like a premium magazine illustration. A clean side-view silhouette of a human head and brain formed entirely out of tiny children's playground equipment and toy building blocks — slides, swings, ladders, seesaws, bricks — cleverly assembled into the brain shape, floating on a seamless dark charcoal #323232 background. Whimsical yet intelligent and sophisticated. Mostly off-white #f8f8f8 and charcoal, with restrained pops of a single signature red #aa0a0a on a few of the pieces. Generous negative space around the head. One small off-white condensed word 'PLAY' sits in the lower-left. The ONLY text is 'PLAY'. Distinctive and ownable — clearly NOT a generic glowing-brain diagram. High contrast, mobile-legible. Keep the bottom-right corner clear.

label: The lone goalie / unnecessary obstacle (Suits paradox, 'ON PURPOSE?')
prompt: A striking, slightly surreal 16:9 YouTube thumbnail shot from a dramatic high overhead angle. A single tiny goalkeeper stands utterly alone in the centre of an enormous empty football goal, on a dark charcoal #323232 pitch marked with faint off-white #f8f8f8 lines, dwarfed by the vast net around him, arms slightly raised. The absurdity of a person voluntarily standing guard just to make scoring harder is visualised through the scale and emptiness. Minimal, graphic, cinematic, huge dark negative space. A single red #aa0a0a football sits on the penalty spot — the only colour accent. Bold off-white condensed sans-serif text in the upper area reads exactly 'ON PURPOSE?'. The ONLY text is 'ON PURPOSE?'. Clever, premium, unexpected. Keep the bottom-right corner clear. Legible at small size.
